0022600109.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 9th in the West, 3rd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) host the San Antonio Spurs (0-1, 12th in the West, 5th in the Southwest, one game back) in Dallas's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas on a W1 streak, 1-1 in its last ten, and yet to play at home. The teams haven't met yet this season, but Dallas lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (out, shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain).
